response.query: If cooperating RECs limit access, what contingency data sources and protocols (redacted researcher copies, composite case documents, FOI appeals) ensure analytic validity and traceability?

results.title: Too Good to Be True: How TMS Damaged My Brain
results.content: At the end of the visit, he asked me, “How long have you been feeling depressed?” After I told him about my history, he brought up TMS, describing it as a breakthrough treatment that did not involve taking a pill. So I get to live my life as a mental patient (and have my family destroyed and everything I ever worked for removed from me unlawfully) because they don’t like reality and deny me my human right to not be tortured and kidnapped should a bus driver I had a disagreement with decides to refer me for mental health treatment after ‘spiking’ me with date rape drugs. (5) Operations Manager/ Consultant Psychiatrist who got involved when the lawyers started asking for the unredacted documents and she realise not only the Community Nurse and FOI Officer were in a little bit of shctuck, but the hospitals reputation (and that of police) were going to suffer as a result.
